audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Steadfast Presence's dash-stop as a PASSIVE aura: 'Poppy's W passive grounds nearby dashers', 'her permanent W-cancel', 'she just holds W and grounds your dashes'. Riot's text splits the ability: the passive half is only Armor and Magic Resist (increasing as she drops low); the dash-stop is the ACTIVATED half, on 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.why: This is the difference between an unplayable lane and a readable one. If the grounding were passive there would be no window at all; because it is a 20s button at rank 1, the correct play is to bait it with a cheap dash and run the real pattern in the gap. The page's own advice ('never commit a dash while her W active is up') already implies an active — the rest of the text contradicts it.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence is an active on 20s at rank 1. Bait it, then engage. Its passive half is armour/MR only.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early paragraph says her W cancels 'your Q (Bladesurge) dash and E (Flawless Duet) mid-cast'. Flawless Duet is not a dash — it is two converging blades cast at range 850.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence stops enemy DASHES. Bladesurge is the dash; Flawless Duet is not, so it is not stopped by W. Telling the player their stun gets cancelled removes the one tool that still works into a held W.
audit.corrected: W stops Bladesurge only. Your E still lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict's channel and untargetability were never mentioned, and Iron Ambassador's shield is absent entirely.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both: she goes untargetable through your commit on R, and her passive buckler pickup gives a shield that eats your burst. Her R being an interruptible channel means your Flawless Duet cancels it — the counterplay line the entry was missing.
audit.corrected: E-stun cancels Keeper's Verdict; don't dump a combo into the wind-up while she is untargetable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows contradicted their whys text: whys[1] says you 'trade back evenly' with the row reading Poppy, whys[4] calls Level 6 'your one clean all-in' with the row reading Skill, whys[5] says 'the lane stays a coinflip' with the row reading Poppy.
audit.why: The packet chart (Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Irelia, Skill, Poppy) matches the prose. This is a losing lane at 46.58% and the chart should stay mostly hers — only these three rows were wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4, 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item spike named Trinity Force in whys[5] and spikes[3].text against an itemization block that builds Blade of the Ruined King; and Irelia's passive credited with armour shred in whys[6], mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[2] and the TL;DR.
audit.why: Ionian Fervor is attack speed plus bonus on-hit, not shred — and against a Poppy stacking armour that gets stronger at low health, %HP damage is exactly the thing worth naming.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Poppy 'he/his' in tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding and phases[4].why while the content layer uses 'she'.
audit.why: Same-page pronoun conflict undermines the specific advice next to it.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood; the remaining instances live in shared template strings and are flagged in notes.

edits.before: Poppy is built to counter how you play — her W (Steadfast Presence) grounds you and hard-cancels your Q (Bladesurge) dash and E (Flawless Duet) mid-cast, so you can't just dash onto the wave and reset through her. At Level 1-3 don't throw a Q at a minion next to her or step into E range near a wall: her E (Heroic Charge) shoves you into terrain for a multi-second stun and she follows with her Q (Hammer Shock) zone for a huge chunk. Farm with the tip of your Q off the back of the wave, respect that her W passive gives her MR and slow resistance so your early pressure stalls, and never commit a dash while her W active is up.
edits.after: Poppy is built to counter how you play — Steadfast Presence (W) stops your Q (Bladesurge) dash outright and leaves you slowed and grounded. But it is an ACTIVE on 20s at rank 1, not an aura: bait it with a cheap dash and the window afterwards is yours. Your E (Flawless Duet) is not a dash, so it still lands into a held W. At Level 1-3 don't step into E range near a wall — Heroic Charge shoves you into terrain for the stun and she follows with the Hammer Shock (Q) zone. Farm off the back of the wave, and respect that her W passive stacks armour and MR harder the lower she drops.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay rough — her cooldowns are short and she keeps grounding you with W. Level 6 is your one real window: Vanguard's Edge (R) drops a blade wall behind her so she can't W-cancel her way out or peel back, and that's when you finally land E-stun into a Bladesurge reset chain and let your passive armor-shred ramp. Bait her W active down first — once it's on cooldown your dashes actually land — then E-Q in, pop W (Defiant Dance) to tank her Q-zone and any follow-up, and stick with resets. If her W and E are both up and you're near a wall, walk away; you do not win that trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay rough — Hammer Shock is 5s by rank 4 and every Steadfast Presence read costs you a dash. Level 6 is your one real window: Vanguard's Edge (R) drops a blade wall behind her so she can't peel back out, and that's when you chain E-stun into a Bladesurge reset with Ionian Fervor at max stacks. Bait her W first — 20s at rank 1, so once it's spent your dashes actually land — then E-Q in, pop Defiant Dance to tank her Q-zone, and stick with resets. Her R is a channel: your E-stun cancels Keeper's Verdict outright. If her W and E are both up near a wall, walk away.

edits.before: This stays an uphill lane. Poppy builds tank and her W keeps cancelling your engage long after laning, so your reset DPS never gets the clean uninterrupted fight it needs to ramp. Your mid-game lead is the whole game plan — convert your Level 6 and first-item windows into objectives and tempo before her tank items make your shred irrelevant. In teamfights her R (Keeper's Verdict) can launch you out of your own dive with a full-charge knockback, so engage from an angle where she can't line it up on you, and don't drop into a 1v1 where she just holds W and grounds your dashes.

notes: The central error here is structural, not cosmetic: the entry treats Poppy's dash-stop as a permanent passive aura ('her permanent W-cancel'), when Riot's text puts the dash-stop on the ACTIVE half of Steadfast Presence at 20/18/16/14/12s — the passive half is armour and MR only. That single fact turns the matchup from 'unplayable, she always cancels you' into 'bait a 20-second button, then run your pattern', which is the actual game. Second error: her W was said to cancel Flawless Duet mid-cast; W stops dashes and Flawless Duet is not a dash, so the stun still lands into a held W. Keeper's Verdict's channel and untargetability were both missing and are now stated.
